scenario_set.synthesis: Markets are shrugging off the risks. The Fed raised rates with the ten-year Treasury yield at 5% and the Strait of Hormuz closed. Yet the VIX fell to its lowest level in this stretch. The strain shows in which stocks are rising: fewer and fewer of them. Crypto broke $80K for a different reason. So stocks and crypto now move on different drivers and get separate rows. Two events decide the week ahead. First, the Oct 6-8 Treasury auctions: will buyers again demand a record-high yield, as at the 20-year sale? Second, memory chips: can they keep up a group of AI stocks that now draws nine of every ten new AI dollars?
scenario_set.probability_check: Our most likely scenario scored 5.0 of the last 8 graded weeks. It came fully true once. Its average Brier score, a measure of forecast error where lower is better, was 0.24 across four scored weeks. The record shows it usually gets the direction right but comes only partly true. That argues for tighter target ranges, not a higher probability. It stays at 45%.
